# reelsmith
**A video editing harness for AI coding agents.**
reelsmith gives a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Cursor or any MCP client) a re

al video
editor: a timeline of tracks, clips, keyframes, text and components that it edits with tool

s and code, looks at
frame by frame, and renders through checks that will not let a broken film out.
The agent builds the film clip by clip from footage, pictures, narration and its own React componen

ts, the way a
person works in an editing app.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
There is no pipeline and no template. Every tool can be called at any time, `project.json` can be ed

ited by hand,
and the agent decides the story, the cut, the sound and the look. reelsmith takes care

of the mechanics: valid and
undoable edits, timing, rendering, layout measurement, loudness and the

s: valid and
undoable edits, timing, rendering, layout measurement, loudness and the delivery rules.
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Attach it to your coding agent, in the folder you run the agent in:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then ask: *"Cut my talk in ~/videos/talk.mp4 to its best 90 seconds, remove the pauses, add English

captions and a
title card."* or *"Make a 60-second vertical explainer on why tea leaves curl."*
Needs Python 3.10+, Node.js 20+ and ffmpeg on `PATH`; `reelsmith doctor` checks all of it, and what

each optional
tool needs. reelsmith reads its manual and renderer from the checkout, so keep the edi
tool needs. reelsmith reads its manual and renderer from the checkout, so keep the editable install.
## Let your coding agent set it up
Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any coding agent:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It asks where to install and before installing any system tool, checks the machine with `reelsmith d

octor`,
attaches itself with `reelsmith setup <agent>` and renders a test film without a paid call.
## What the agent can do
- **Edit a timeline.** Visual, audio and caption tracks; image, video, text, shape, evidence and com

ponent clips;
keyframes with easing, Ken Burns moves, enter/exit presets, transitions, flips, filter

s and blend modes. Edits
are atomic batches, validated and undoable.
- **Edit footage.** Probe a rec

ording, look at stills at any source second, find shot cuts and silences, get a
word-level transcrip

t; cut with `"src:clip@12.4"` anchors, markers, ripple delete, insert gap and trim; reframe
landscap
e footage for a vertical canvas with keyframed focus; speed curves, freeze frames and reverse; volum

e
curves and ducking under the voice.
- **Captions and chapters.** Captions from the narration or fr

om a transcript, following it through every cut,
shown phrase by phrase or word by word, burned in a

nd delivered as `.srt` and `.vtt`; chapters from markers.
- **Time to anything.** Times anchor on na

rration lines, clips, markers or source seconds (`"line:5+0.3"`,
`"clip:c2.end-0.5"`, `"mark:intro"`

, `"end-2"`): re-record the voice or recut a clip and the edit follows.
- **Look at its own work.**

`describe` prints the editor's window as text; `preview` renders any moments in seconds
with a conta
ct sheet and measured layout problems; a draft render shows a stretch as video; `review` shows frame

s
of the delivered film.
- **Make assets.** Narration (text-to-speech, cached per line), pictures (C

odex image generation), evidence
screenshots of web pages with the proving sentence boxed, short cli

ps from a picture (image-to-video), and
imports of local or downloaded media, animated GIFs included

.
- **Write its own components.** Nine built-in React presets, and a documented kit for the agent's

own components in
the workspace library, type-checked and import-guarded.
- **Any canvas, any langua

ge.** `landscape` (the default, 1920×1080), `vertical`, `square`, `portrait`, platform
profiles (`yo

utube`, `tiktok`, `shorts`, `reels`, `douyin`) and custom sizes and frame rates (NTSC included); a
`
locale` sets caption phrasing, the words components add, capture language and web requests; workspac

es can add
fonts.
[该节后续省略]
## Coding agents
| agent | how |
| Claude Code | `reelsmith setup claude-code`, or the plugin: `/plugin marketplace add wangkant/reel

smith`, then `/plugin install reelsmith@reelsmith` |
| Codex | `reelsmith setup codex` |
| DeepSeek
Harness | the plugin in integrations/dsh (a Video editor mode with a film, preview and timeline pane

l), or `reelsmith setup dsh` |
| Cursor | `reelsmith setup cursor` |
| any MCP client | `reelsmith s

etup generic`, or run the server yourself: `reelsmith mcp` (stdio) or `reelsmith mcp --http` |
| no
client | `reelsmith run <project> --brief "..."`: an agent makes the film headless, on reelsmith's o
wn loop over any OpenAI-compatible API, or on Codex, DeepSeek Harness or the Claude Agent SDK (`--en
over any OpenAI-compatible API, or on Codex, DeepSeek Harness or the Claude Agent SDK (`--engine`) |

Every agent gets the same tools and the reelsmith skill (skills/reelsmith/SKILL.md).
docs/agents.md
covers each one, the HTTP transport and headless runs.
## Workspaces and projects
A workspace is a folder for one creator or channel; its projects share settings, rules, keys, a comp

onent library
and the agent's notes:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

examples/workspace is a starter; examples also has one channel's setup to show
what a workspace can
pin down. Every agent tool is also a command, for scripts and people (`reelsmith --help`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Optional services
| for | you need |
| `capture` (web page evidence) | the `capture` extra and Edge, Chrome or `python -m playwright inst

all chromium` |
| `draw` (pictures) | the Codex CLI, signed in |
| `speak` (narration) | an OpenRout
er key (the default voice speaks English and Mandarin), or any OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint (`p

roviders.tts.provider: "openai"`) |
| `animate` (image-to-video) | an OpenRouter key |
| `transcribe
` | any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint (OpenAI, Groq, a local whisper server), or the `tra

nscribe` extra (faster-whisper, on your machine) |
| `reelsmith run` | a model API key (OpenRouter b
y default; DeepSeek, OpenAI or a local server), or Codex or DeepSeek Harness installed; the `runner`
extra for the Claude Agent SDK engine |
Paid calls estimate first and are refused over `budget.per_project_usd` (default $1) or under the ac

count floor
